title: How to Build Custom Dashboards for Each Property Manager
summary: See how each property manager can get a personalized dashboard view relevant to their own portfolio.
body_markdown:
Building custom dashboards per property manager means each manager sees a **Home** view centered on their own assigned properties, not a generic company-wide dashboard that buries their relevant data among everyone else's. In **Jestor** , **Home** can be configured per user or per profile.


Property managers overseeing a subset of a larger portfolio don't need visibility into the whole company's data — they need a fast, relevant view of exactly what they're responsible for.


## What generic dashboards get wrong for property managers


- One shared dashboard that mixes every manager's properties together
- Managers having to filter through irrelevant data to find their own properties
- No personalization reflecting what each manager actually needs to see day to day
- Slower decision-making because relevant data isn't surfaced by default


## How personalized dashboards per manager work


- **Home** can be configured per user, centralizing what matters to their specific role
- Dashboards can filter automatically to show only the manager's assigned properties
- Indicators relevant to their specific responsibilities can be prioritized in their view
- Each manager's Home stays personalized without needing a separate dashboard built from scratch each time


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Personalization applies at the Home and dashboard level, not just cosmetic settings
- Property managers get faster access to what's actually relevant to them
- The same underlying data supports many different personalized views
- Scales naturally as more managers and properties join the portfolio

## Frequently Asked Questions


**Can each property manager's Home be configured individually?** Yes, Home can be set per user or per profile. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Does this require building a separate dashboard for every manager?** It can be configured efficiently using shared templates adapted per profile.


**Can managers still see portfolio-wide data if needed?** That depends on the permissions configured for their role.
